title: Momoi Airi — Solo Show Strategy Meeting!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: One month before the solo show
Rental Meeting Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, about today's meeting...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Saito gave me the final layout for the venue the other day, so I'd like to have a discussion about that.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Here, we can use this space.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay. Thanks, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So... What's changed?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Where the equipment's going to be placed on the right and lefthand sides of the stage. It looks like they're going to be placed more towards the edges.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that means we'll be able to use almost all of the stage!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And it'll make it easier for us to see everyone sitting in those sections.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, the equipment's pretty big too. I like the idea of moving them since they'd sorta dominate the show if you're sitting right next to them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, going forward with this means we're gonna need to rethink how we perform certain songs.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, why?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that's right... Our second song...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Our second song? Um... Oh, are you talking about the interlude...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? I still don't get it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's okay, Minori.
Lemme explain how things are gonna go when we're actually on stage.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For our first song, we're gonna walk around as much of the stage as we can to get a good look at all of our fans' faces.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Do you remember where you're supposed to stand at the end, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! Haruka and I are stage left, and you and Shizuku are stage right!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Correct. We'll stay in those positions and sing our second song until its interlude. Then, we'll walk out on stage to look at our fans, and meet back in the middle... Well, that was the plan...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And there lies the problem.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? So, this is the part you were talking about just now? About changing where the equipment is gonna be placed and how it'll affect the show?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, changing where they're placed will allow us to use more of the stage. You follow me there, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because we'll get to use more of the stage, we'll have to physically travel greater distances.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right, so...!
Hm? Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I vaguely remember us talking a while back about trying to travel as much as we possibly could for the second song's interlude...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, we did.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As a result of these changes, we can't move as much as we initially planned for this part anymore because otherwise we won't make it in time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, what?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wait! What if we ran instead of walking?! Wouldn't that solve the problem?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but it may end up taking away from the dance we'll be doing following the interlude.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. Especially since our original goal was to conserve our energy, build up some anticipation and stun the audience by performing a fun and dynamic dance routine for them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Y-You're right...!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is one of the parts we really focused on and practiced a lot for...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's no guarantee that what we want to show is what our fans actually want to see.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Given those options, I'll always prioritize the enjoyment of our fans over our own objectives.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Then...
Do we need to change the dance routine after the interlude?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's the easiest solution...
But we need to keep the energy going for the second half of our show, so not changing it would be best.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. So, why don't we try thinking about what else we can do?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Like... Changing the way we move during the interlude, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And seeing exactly how much more space we'll have based on where the equipment is going to be moved.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, we'll be able to measure how much more time we'll need to travel that extra distance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I know!
What if we did this?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, you wanna extend the interlude?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm thinking that we can extend the song by looping a part of the interlude. That should give us the time we need to move around.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll need to test this to make sure it'll work, but it should be okay since it's not that big a change. Plus, it shouldn't affect the other parts of our show much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and if this works, our dance routine should go just as we initially planned.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's actually pretty common to extend the interlude for a song to give everyone more time to engage with their fans during shows...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And the fans usually end up enjoying these moments.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then it's settled! I'll ask Saito right away to see if this idea will work.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, lemme jot that down...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What are you writing, Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm writing down everything I learned during today's meeting!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We made these sorts of adjustments to the performance we did for the fan event, but I always seem to learn something new whenever we go through this process.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, that's very studious of you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And it's a good idea too since sudden changes can lead to causing a lot of people a lot of trouble...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'm sure our show will go well after holding discussions like this together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And if it means putting smiles on all of our fans' faces, then we gotta do everything we can!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!
